setup.target: the orders service under apps/orders in the shop monorepo, started locally with `python3 -m orders` on port 8073, and its hand-off to the mailer through the shared outbox; the mailer sends real mail and is not run by the harness.
setup.findings: apps/orders/README.md:9 gives the start command and port; orders/server.py:73 reads `ORDERS_PORT`, `ORDERS_DB`, and `SHOP_OUTBOX`; README.md:12 at the repo root says the mail-sink folder forwards to the team's shared inbox; REQUIREMENTS.md holds SR-1 to SR-3.
setup.looked_in: README.md, apps/orders/README.md, apps/orders/REQUIREMENTS.md, apps/orders/orders/, apps/mailer/README.md, apps/mailer/worker.js.
setup.doctor_proof: saved output in evidence/doctor/setup.txt: ready after Start (exit 0), not ready after Stop (exit 1), on the commit recorded there.

commands.start: python3 .claude/skills/verify-orders/scripts/framework/vf.py start --checkout orders={checkout:orders} --until "curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8073/health" -- env PYTHONPATH={checkout:orders} python3 {checkout:orders}/orders/server.py

doctor.use_when: before driving the API by hand or running a check, or when a check stopped with "not ready".
doctor.environment: an instance started with the Start command in `harness.json`; the project root is `apps/orders`.
doctor.result: prints `ready` and the loaded code's commit as JSON, exit 0.
doctor.failure: exit 1 with one reason per line; exit 2 when it could not tell. Start the service with the Start command, or restart it after editing code.
doctor.limits: says the process is up on the recorded code; says nothing about the data in it or about the mailer.

probe.use_when: checking an order after placing it, or seeing which confirmation jobs are pending.
probe.inputs: the order ID; `outbox` lists every job in the shared outbox with its status.
probe.environment: the database at `data/orders.db` under apps/orders (or `ORDERS_DB`) and the outbox at `../../queue/outbox.jsonl` (or `SHOP_OUTBOX`); the service need not be running.
probe.permissions: read-only; opens the database read-only and imports no app code.
probe.result: one JSON object: the order row with its lines and total, or `{"jobs": [...]}`.
probe.failure: exit 1 with `{"not_found": ..., "hint": ...}` when the order has no row; exit 2 with `STOPPED: <reason>` when the database or outbox is unreadable.
probe.limits: reports stored state only; a pending job says nothing about whether mail was sent.
